name: Aojuuji Byouin Tokyo-to Shibu Kaii Kaibou Busho
original_name: 青十字病院　東京都支部　怪異解剖部署
source:
In Japan in 1999, a number of horrific incidents have been occurring, caused by "eidolons" which are the embodiment of urban legends.The protagonist belongs to a mysterious organization called "Aojuji Hospital" and becomes involved in the horrific incidents caused by these mysterious beings.

Set against the backdrop of a Japan where eschatology and urban legends have become societal phenomena, the intertwined destinies of "folklore," "urban legends," and "paranormal" lead to a climactic finale...

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2448200/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
1999年的日本，发生了多起由都市传说化身“幻灵”引发的恐怖事件。主角隶属于一个名为“青树寺医院”的神秘组织，并卷入了这些神秘生物引发的恐怖事件。

以末世论和都市传说成为社会现象的日本为背景，“民间传说”、“都市传说”和“超自然”的命运交织在一起，最终迎来了高潮……

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2448200/]Steam[/url]]
